question: Do I need a meal plan if I live in a residence hall?

expected.anchor: Every student living in a residence hall must hold a meal plan for the whole semester

question: À quelle heure est le brunch du week-end au restaurant universitaire ?
question_en: What time is weekend brunch at the dining hall?

question: How many guests can I bring to the dining hall?

expected.anchor: A student may bring up to two guests per week

question: What is the late payment fee if I don't pay tuition on time?

expected.anchor: A late payment fee of 500 MAD is charged once per semester

question: Suis-je remboursé si je me retire de l'université avant le début des cours ?
question_en: Do I get a refund if I withdraw from the university before classes start?
topic: finance, page 2, overlaps the catalog's refund rules

expected.anchor: receives a full refund of tuition, minus a processing fee of 1,000 MAD

question: Can I pay my tuition in installments?

expected.anchor: Students may split tuition into three equal installments per semester

question: Do engineering students need their advisor's approval to drop a course?
topic: academic, overlaps the catalog's add/drop rules

expected.anchor: need written approval from their academic advisor before adding or dropping any course

question: Combien de temps la formation de sécurité en laboratoire reste-t-elle valable ?
question_en: How long is the laboratory safety training valid?

expected.anchor: The training certificate is valid for two academic years

question: How long does the engineering internship have to be?
topic: academic, overlaps the catalog's internship rules

expected.anchor: complete an internship of at least eight weeks before their final year
